  13  def is_generator(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Generator]:

  23  def is_sequence_but_not_string(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[Sequence]:
  24      """Return True if ``obj`` is a sequence that isn't a string."""
  25      return isinstance(obj, Sequence) and not isinstance(obj, (str, bytes))
  26

  29      """Return True if ``obj`` is a collection type, e.g. list, tuple, queryset."""

  34  def is_aware(datetime: dt.datetime) -> bool:

  40  def from_timestamp(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  41      if value is True or value is False:
  42          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  43      value = float(value)
  44      if value < 0:

  47      # Load a timestamp with utc as timezone to prevent using system timezone.
  48      # Then set timezone to None, to let the Field handle adding timezone info.
  49      try:
  50          return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:
  54          raise ValueError("Error converting value to datetime") from exc
  55

  58      if value is True or value is False:

  85      ::
  86  
  87          >>> dlist = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'foo'}, {'id': 2, 'name': 'bar'}]
  88          >>> pluck(dlist, 'id')

  99      this method by default to access attributes of the source object. For object `x`
 100      and attribute `i`, this method first tries to access `x[i]`, and then falls back to
 101      `x.i` if an exception is raised.
 102  
 103      .. warning::
 104          If an object `x` does not raise an exception when `x[i]` does not exist,
 105          `get_value` will never check the value `x.i`. Consider overriding
 106          `marshmallow.fields.Field.get_value` in this case.
 107      """
 108      if "." in key:
 109          for k in key.split("."):
 110              obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, k, default)
 111      else:
 112          obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default)
 113      return obj

 116  def _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default):
 117      if not hasattr(obj, "__getitem__"):
 118          return getattr(obj, key, default)
 119  
 120      try:

 122      except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError):
 123          return getattr(obj, key, default)

 126  def set_value(dct: dict[str, typing.Any], key: str, value: typing.Any):
 127      """Set a value in a dict. If `key` contains a '.', it is assumed
 128      to be a path (i.e. dot-delimited string) to the value's location.
 129  
 130      ::
 131  
 132          >>> d = {}
 133          >>> set_value(d, 'foo.bar', 42)
 134          >>> d
 135          {'foo': {'bar': 42}}
 136      """
 137      if "." in key:
 138          head, rest = key.split(".", 1)
 139          target = dct.setdefault(head, {})
 140          if not isinstance(target, dict):
 141              raise ValueError(
 142                  f"Cannot set {key} in {head} due to existing value: {target}"
 143              )
 144          set_value(target, rest, value)
 145      else:

 151      if not callable(obj):

 157      """Compute the total microseconds of a timedelta.
 158  
 159      https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.13.1/Lib/_pydatetime.py#L805-L807
 160      """
 161      return (value.days * (24 * 3600) + value.seconds) * 1000000 + value.microseconds

 128      to be a path (i.e. dot-delimited string) to the value's location.
 129  
 130      ::
 131  
 132          >>> d = {}
 133          >>> set_value(d, 'foo.bar', 42)
 134          >>> d
 135          {'foo': {'bar': 42}}
 136      """

 139          target = dct.setdefault(head, {})
 140          if not isinstance(target, dict):
 141              raise ValueError(

1  """Utility methods for marshmallow."""
   2  
   3  from __future__ import annotations
   4  
   5  import datetime as dt
   6  import inspect
   7  import typing
   8  from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
   9  
  10  from marshmallow.constants import missing
  11  
  12  
  13  def is_generator(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Generator]:
  14      """Return True if ``obj`` is a generator."""
  15      return inspect.isgeneratorfunction(obj) or inspect.isgenerator(obj)
  16  
  17  
  18  def is_iterable_but_not_string(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Iterable]:
  19      """Return True if ``obj`` is an iterable object that isn't a string."""
  20      return (hasattr(obj, "__iter__") and not hasattr(obj, "strip")) or is_generator(obj)
  21  
  22  
  23  def is_sequence_but_not_string(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[Sequence]:
  24      """Return True if ``obj`` is a sequence that isn't a string."""
  25      return isinstance(obj, Sequence) and not isinstance(obj, (str, bytes))
  26  
  27  
  28  def is_collection(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Iterable]:
  29      """Return True if ``obj`` is a collection type, e.g. list, tuple, queryset."""
  30      return is_iterable_but_not_string(obj) and not isinstance(obj, Mapping)
  31  
  32  
  33  # https://stackoverflow.com/a/27596917
  34  def is_aware(datetime: dt.datetime) -> bool:
  35      return (
  36          datetime.tzinfo is not None and datetime.tzinfo.utcoffset(datetime) is not None
  37      )
  38  
  39  
  40  def from_timestamp(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  41      if value is True or value is False:
  42          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  43      value = float(value)
  44      if value < 0:
  45          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  46  
  47      # Load a timestamp with utc as timezone to prevent using system timezone.
  48      # Then set timezone to None, to let the Field handle adding timezone info.
  49      try:
  50          return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:
  54          raise ValueError("Error converting value to datetime") from exc
  55  
  56  
  57  def from_timestamp_ms(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  58      if value is True or value is False:
  59          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  60      value = float(value)
  61      return from_timestamp(value / 1000)
  62  
  63  
  64  def timestamp(
  65      value: dt.datetime,
  66  ) -> float:
  67      if not is_aware(value):
  68          # When a date is naive, use UTC as zone info to prevent using system timezone.
  69          value = value.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
  70      return value.timestamp()
  71  
  72  
  73  def timestamp_ms(value: dt.datetime) -> float:
  74      return timestamp(value) * 1000
  75  
  76  
  77  def ensure_text_type(val: str | bytes) -> str:
  78      if isinstance(val, bytes):
  79          val = val.decode("utf-8")
  80      return str(val)
  81  
  82  
  83  def pluck(dictlist: list[dict[str, typing.Any]], key: str):
  84      """Extracts a list of dictionary values from a list of dictionaries.
  85      ::
  86  
  87          >>> dlist = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'foo'}, {'id': 2, 'name': 'bar'}]
  88          >>> pluck(dlist, 'id')
  89          [1, 2]
  90      """
  91      return [d[key] for d in dictlist]

  94  # Various utilities for pulling keyed values from objects

  97  def get_nested_value(obj, key: str, default=missing):
  98      """Helper for pulling a keyed value off various types of objects. Fields use
  99      this method by default to access attributes of the source object. For object `x`
 100      and attribute `i`, this method first tries to access `x[i]`, and then falls back to
 101      `x.i` if an exception is raised.
 102  
 103      .. warning::
 104          If an object `x` does not raise an exception when `x[i]` does not exist,
 105          `get_value` will never check the value `x.i`. Consider overriding
 106          `marshmallow.fields.Field.get_value` in this case.
 107      """
 108      if "." in key:
 109          for k in key.split("."):
 110              obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, k, default)
 111      else:
 112          obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default)
 113      return obj

 116  def _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default):

  37      )

  40  def from_timestamp(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  41      if value is True or value is False:
  42          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  43      value = float(value)
  44      if value < 0:
  45          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")

  47      # Load a timestamp with utc as timezone to prevent using system timezone.
  48      # Then set timezone to None, to let the Field handle adding timezone info.
  49      try:
  50          return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:
  54          raise ValueError("Error converting value to datetime") from exc

  88          >>> pluck(dlist, 'id')

  97  def get_nested_value(obj, key: str, default=missing):
  98      """Helper for pulling a keyed value off various types of objects. Fields use
  99      this method by default to access attributes of the source object. For object `x`
 100      and attribute `i`, this method first tries to access `x[i]`, and then falls back to
 101      `x.i` if an exception is raised.
 102  
 103      .. warning::
 104          If an object `x` does not raise an exception when `x[i]` does not exist,
 105          `get_value` will never check the value `x.i`. Consider overriding
 106          `marshmallow.fields.Field.get_value` in this case.
 107      """
 108      if "." in key:
 109          for k in key.split("."):
 110              obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, k, default)
 111      else:
 112          obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default)
 113      return obj

 116  def _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default):
 117      if not hasattr(obj, "__getitem__"):
 118          return getattr(obj, key, default)
 119  
 120      try:
 121          return obj[key]
 122      except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError):
 123          return getattr(obj, key, default)

 126  def set_value(dct: dict[str, typing.Any], key: str, value: typing.Any):
 127      """Set a value in a dict. If `key` contains a '.', it is assumed
 128      to be a path (i.e. dot-delimited string) to the value's location.
 129  
 130      ::
 131  
 132          >>> d = {}
 133          >>> set_value(d, 'foo.bar', 42)
 134          >>> d
 135          {'foo': {'bar': 42}}
 136      """
 137      if "." in key:
 138          head, rest = key.split(".", 1)
 139          target = dct.setdefault(head, {})
 140          if not isinstance(target, dict):
 141              raise ValueError(
 142                  f"Cannot set {key} in {head} due to existing value: {target}"
 143              )
 144          set_value(target, rest, value)
 145      else:
 146          dct[key] = value

 151      if not callable(obj):

 157      """Compute the total microseconds of a timedelta.
 158  
 159      https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.13.1/Lib/_pydatetime.py#L805-L807
 160      """

1  """Utility methods for marshmallow."""
   2  
   3  from __future__ import annotations
   4  
   5  import datetime as dt
   6  import inspect
   7  import typing
   8  from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
   9  
  10  from marshmallow.constants import missing
  11  
  12  
  13  def is_generator(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Generator]:
  14      """Return True if ``obj`` is a generator."""
  15      return inspect.isgeneratorfunction(obj) or inspect.isgenerator(obj)
  16  
  17  
  18  def is_iterable_but_not_string(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Iterable]:
  19      """Return True if ``obj`` is an iterable object that isn't a string."""
  20      return (hasattr(obj, "__iter__") and not hasattr(obj, "strip")) or is_generator(obj)
  21  
  22  
  23  def is_sequence_but_not_string(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[Sequence]:
  24      """Return True if ``obj`` is a sequence that isn't a string."""
  25      return isinstance(obj, Sequence) and not isinstance(obj, (str, bytes))
  26  
  27  
  28  def is_collection(obj) -> typing.TypeGuard[typing.Iterable]:
  29      """Return True if ``obj`` is a collection type, e.g. list, tuple, queryset."""
  30      return is_iterable_but_not_string(obj) and not isinstance(obj, Mapping)
  31  
  32  
  33  # https://stackoverflow.com/a/27596917
  34  def is_aware(datetime: dt.datetime) -> bool:
  35      return (
  36          datetime.tzinfo is not None and datetime.tzinfo.utcoffset(datetime) is not None
  37      )
  38  
  39  
  40  def from_timestamp(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  41      if value is True or value is False:
  42          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  43      value = float(value)
  44      if value < 0:
  45          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  46  
  47      # Load a timestamp with utc as timezone to prevent using system timezone.
  48      # Then set timezone to None, to let the Field handle adding timezone info.
  49      try:
  50          return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:
  54          raise ValueError("Error converting value to datetime") from exc
  55  
  56  
  57  def from_timestamp_ms(value: typing.Any) -> dt.datetime:
  58      if value is True or value is False:
  59          raise ValueError("Not a valid POSIX timestamp")
  60      value = float(value)
  61      return from_timestamp(value / 1000)
  62  
  63  
  64  def timestamp(
  65      value: dt.datetime,
  66  ) -> float:
  67      if not is_aware(value):
  68          # When a date is naive, use UTC as zone info to prevent using system timezone.
  69          value = value.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
  70      return value.timestamp()
  71  
  72  
  73  def timestamp_ms(value: dt.datetime) -> float:
  74      return timestamp(value) * 1000
  75  
  76  
  77  def ensure_text_type(val: str | bytes) -> str:
  78      if isinstance(val, bytes):
  79          val = val.decode("utf-8")
  80      return str(val)
  81  
  82  
  83  def pluck(dictlist: list[dict[str, typing.Any]], key: str):
  84      """Extracts a list of dictionary values from a list of dictionaries.
  85      ::
  86  
  87          >>> dlist = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'foo'}, {'id': 2, 'name': 'bar'}]
  88          >>> pluck(dlist, 'id')
  89          [1, 2]
  90      """
  91      return [d[key] for d in dictlist]
  92  
  93  
  94  # Various utilities for pulling keyed values from objects
  95  
  96  
  97  def get_nested_value(obj, key: str, default=missing):
  98      """Helper for pulling a keyed value off various types of objects. Fields use
  99      this method by default to access attributes of the source object. For object `x`
 100      and attribute `i`, this method first tries to access `x[i]`, and then falls back to
 101      `x.i` if an exception is raised.
 102  
 103      .. warning::
 104          If an object `x` does not raise an exception when `x[i]` does not exist,
 105          `get_value` will never check the value `x.i`. Consider overriding
 106          `marshmallow.fields.Field.get_value` in this case.
 107      """
 108      if "." in key:
 109          for k in key.split("."):
 110              obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, k, default)
 111      else:
 112          obj = _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default)
 113      return obj
 114  
 115  
 116  def _get_value_for_key(obj, key, default):
 117      if not hasattr(obj, "__getitem__"):
 118          return getattr(obj, key, default)
 119  
 120      try:
 121          return obj[key]
 122      except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError):
 123          return getattr(obj, key, default)
 124  
 125  
 126  def set_value(dct: dict[str, typing.Any], key: str, value: typing.Any):
 127      """Set a value in a dict. If `key` contains a '.', it is assumed
 128      to be a path (i.e. dot-delimited string) to the value's location.
 129  
 130      ::
 131  
 132          >>> d = {}
 133          >>> set_value(d, 'foo.bar', 42)
 134          >>> d
 135          {'foo': {'bar': 42}}
 136      """
 137      if "." in key:
 138          head, rest = key.split(".", 1)
 139          target = dct.setdefault(head, {})
 140          if not isinstance(target, dict):
 141              raise ValueError(
 142                  f"Cannot set {key} in {head} due to existing value: {target}"
 143              )
 144          set_value(target, rest, value)
 145      else:
 146          dct[key] = value
 147  
 148  
 149  def callable_or_raise(obj):
 150      """Check that an object is callable, else raise a :exc:`TypeError`."""
 151      if not callable(obj):
 152          raise TypeError(f"Object {obj!r} is not callable.")
 153      return obj
 154  
 155  
 156  def timedelta_to_microseconds(value: dt.timedelta) -> int:
 157      """Compute the total microseconds of a timedelta.
 158  
 159      https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.13.1/Lib/_pydatetime.py#L805-L807
 160      """
 161      return (value.days * (24 * 3600) + value.seconds) * 1000000 + value.microseconds

  41      if value is True or value is False:

  51      except OverflowError as exc:
  52          raise ValueError("Timestamp is too large") from exc
  53      except OSError as exc:

 141              raise ValueError(
